claim_title: Intervention raises alpha-helix fraction above baseline (dose-response, direction-specific)

figures.caption: alpha-helix fraction (all generations, invalid->0) vs steering coefficient for CAA at site 28 (primary), site 30, and the SAE-clamp arm; baseline ~0.414. Site-28 CAA rises monotonically; site 30 peaks at coef 2 then collapses; the SAE arm declines.

Direction-specificity at the winning setting (site 28, coef 1.0): alpha-helix fraction for baseline, CAA, matched-control, and same-norm sham. CAA raises helix (+0.068 vs baseline) while both controls show no gain.
